newsitem.title: USA: Italy's Ciampi defends government's 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi defends government's 1997 budget.

text.p: Italy's Treasury and Budget Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi defended his nation's 1997 budget on Tuesday, noting plan contains 62.5 trillion lira in deficit reduction.
"The budget does not appear unbalanced to me" Ciampi told reporters asking him about criticism the government has received from industrialists over heavy taxation in the budget bill.
"The budget bill corresponds exactly to the committment the government took up in its three-year budget plan, which has been approved by parliament" Ciampi said.
Fiat SpA Chairman Cesare Romiti, speaking in Bologna, Italy, said that the budget bill presented to parliament by the government is massive and "topheavy" on the taxation side..
"This is the industrialists' position" Ciampi said when asked to comment.
